articles.summary: A London-based startup is betting that artificial intelligence has created more problems than solutions in sales automation, raising $6.2 million to target some of the economy's most lucrative but hard-to-reach industries with a decidedly human-first approach. articles.title: Base10-backed Throxy challenges AI sales giants with pay-per-meeting model

articles.summary: A London and San Francisco startup is set to expand after securing a significant funding boost to transform outbound sales for hard-to-reach industries.
articles.title: Throxy secures multi-million seed backing
